status: Requested green-dither and pixel-scatter correction saved; remaining visual and camera-fit differences recorded

intro: GSAP background blur builds 2.8–3.05 s, holds through 4.3 s and resolves during the crisp dither handoff by 4.733333 s.
Image-tone SVG halftone, threshold and palette transfer replace a flat dotted layer.
Corrected label swap, typing, control weight/arrow, pixel bits, green-highlight takeover and outgoing control hold.
Retimed the opening camera phases around the control changes.
Revision 44: remove neutral threshold lead-in and share the 4.3 s cue with the System Zero suffix.
identity: Separated abstract identity logo from the pixel product mascot.
Corrected stepped logo-color change and byline typing.
upload-terminal: Rebuilt six classic file icons as native SVG; added Pixelify Sans and underlined any file.
Corrected translucent green menu opening, row typing, hover states and pixel pointer entrance/path/scale.
Removed the menu before the modal and added the ground-first dither plus measured upward sky wipe.
Measured modal dimensions, titlebar, borders, close button and pixel mascot assembly/flicker.
Retimed fullscreen takeover, moved chrome upward, counter-positioned content and removed the desktop leak.
Removed prompt/mascot overlap and corrected prompt typing, active arrows and reframe.
decision: Rebuilt three-stage scatter paths, color flips, percent-only opening and number sequence.
Aligned settled rows while preserving initial scatter positions.
proof: Refined mesh silhouette and logo UV scale.
Rebuilt token/time/cost layouts, values, labels and underlines.
Preserved progress-bar continuity across phase changes.
Measured nonuniform window entry and compensated later positions for the new pivot.
Corrected at once, Decide, units, cost-heading and value timing.
Cost windows resize before their bars appear; content is clipped to the window.
iris-and-cta: Replaced diagonal mask spikes with stepped edges and external pixels.
Reconstructed pixel hand and CTA lettering as native SVG, restored thin strokes and added the bevel.
Corrected button growth, hold and recession.

reading.method: Consecutive readFrames reference windows plus six exact endpoint reads omitted by floating-point range endpoints; native detail reads, measureFrame and trackReference.
reading.trackingReview: Drifted pointer/percentage tracks were rejected despite high fit confidence; native frame edges determined those paths.

sampling.reason: The final scoped changes affect the menu entrance, cost-window resize and upward dither wipe. Each changed window is resampled; other sampled state is unchanged.

compareReference.note: The 0.3 s and 11.67 s samples remain 28. Background-heavy dither/tone moments remain different with the actual supplied landscape. All other latest sampled moments are 25 or less.
